id-20260911-news-1.title: Forest Fire Smoke Worsens, West Kalimantan Emergency Status Extended until September 20 and Spreads to Malaysia-Philippines

segments.src: Musim kemarau panjang yang dipicu fenomena El Nino membuat kondisi kebakaran hutan dan lahan (karhutla) di Kalimantan Barat memasuki fase yang semakin mengkhawatirkan.
segments.tr: The long dry season triggered by the El Nino phenomenon has caused forest and land fire (karhutla) conditions in West Kalimantan to enter an increasingly alarming phase.

segments.src: Pemerintah daerah dilaporkan memperpanjang status siaga darurat bencana asap hingga 20 September, seiring titik panas yang masih terus bermunculan di sejumlah kabupaten.
segments.tr: The local government is reported to have extended the emergency alert status for smoke disasters until September 20, as hotspots continue to emerge in several regencies.
## Cross-Border Smoke Distribution

segments.src: Yang membuat situasi ini berbeda dari tahun-tahun sebelumnya adalah cakupan dampaknya yang meluas hingga lintas negara.
segments.tr: What makes this situation different from previous years is the scope of its impact, which has extended across national borders.

segments.src: Asap dari karhutla di wilayah barat Kalimantan dilaporkan terbawa angin musim hingga ke Sarawak, Malaysia, dengan indeks kualitas udara di beberapa titik dikabarkan menyentuh kategori tidak sehat hingga berbahaya.
segments.tr: Smoke from forest fires in the western region of Kalimantan is reported to have been carried by seasonal winds as far as Sarawak, Malaysia, with air quality indices in several locations reportedly reaching unhealthy to hazardous categories.

segments.src: Otoritas Malaysia dikabarkan mulai membatasi aktivitas luar ruang di sekolah-sekolah pada wilayah yang paling terdampak.
segments.tr: Malaysian authorities are reported to have begun restricting outdoor activities in schools in the most affected areas.

segments.src: Tak berhenti di situ, sejumlah laporan media regional juga menyebut bahwa kabut asap mulai memengaruhi kualitas udara di sebagian wilayah Filipina, meski dengan tingkat keparahan yang bervariasi tergantung pola angin harian.
segments.tr: Not stopping there, several regional media reports also mention that the haze has begun to affect air quality in parts of the Philippines, although with varying levels of severity depending on daily wind patterns.

segments.src: Kondisi ini menegaskan bahwa persoalan karhutla bukan lagi isu domestik semata, melainkan tantangan regional yang membutuhkan koordinasi lintas negara, termasuk melalui kerangka kerja sama ASEAN terkait pencemaran asap lintas batas (transboundary haze).
segments.tr: This condition confirms that the issue of forest fires is no longer just a domestic issue, but a regional challenge that requires cross-border coordination, including through the ASEAN cooperation framework regarding transboundary haze pollution.
## ARI Cases Continue to Rise

segments.src: Di dalam negeri, dinas kesehatan di wilayah terdampak melaporkan tren kenaikan jumlah warga yang memeriksakan diri dengan keluhan infeksi saluran pernapasan akut (ISPA), iritasi mata, dan gangguan pernapasan lainnya.
segments.tr: Domestically, health offices in the affected areas are reporting an upward trend in the number of residents seeking medical attention for complaints of acute respiratory infections (ARI), eye irritation, and other respiratory problems.

segments.src: Kelompok rentan seperti anak-anak, lansia, ibu hamil, dan penderita penyakit pernapasan kronis disebut sebagai yang paling berisiko mengalami dampak kesehatan akibat paparan asap dalam jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Vulnerable groups such as children, the elderly, pregnant women, and people with chronic respiratory diseases are said to be at the highest risk of experiencing health impacts due to long-term smoke exposure.

segments.src: Sejumlah sekolah di beberapa kabupaten dilaporkan sempat meliburkan kegiatan belajar tatap muka atau mengalihkannya ke dalam ruangan sebagai langkah antisipasi.
segments.tr: A number of schools in several regencies are reported to have temporarily suspended face-to-face learning activities or shifted them indoors as an anticipatory measure.

segments.src: Fasilitas kesehatan setempat juga disebut telah menyiapkan posko kesehatan dan pembagian masker bagi warga di titik-titik dengan kualitas udara terburuk.
segments.tr: Local health facilities are also said to have prepared health posts and distributed masks for residents in areas with the worst air quality.
## Steps Taken by the Government

segments.src: Perpanjangan status siaga darurat ini umumnya diikuti dengan sejumlah langkah, seperti:
segments.tr: The extension of this emergency alert status is generally followed by a number of steps, such as:

segments.src: - Pengerahan operasi pemadaman darat dan udara di titik-titik kebakaran lahan gambut yang sulit dijangkau.
segments.tr: - Deployment of ground and aerial firefighting operations in peatland fire spots that are difficult to reach.

segments.src: - Modifikasi cuaca (hujan buatan) di sejumlah wilayah bila kondisi atmosfer memungkinkan.
segments.tr: - Weather modification (artificial rain) in several areas if atmospheric conditions permit.

segments.src: - Penegakan hukum terhadap dugaan praktik pembukaan lahan dengan cara dibakar.
segments.tr: - Law enforcement against suspected land clearing practices using fire.

segments.src: - Imbauan kepada masyarakat untuk mengurangi aktivitas di luar ruangan dan menggunakan alat pelindung diri saat kualitas udara memburuk.
segments.tr: - Appeals to the public to reduce outdoor activities and use personal protective equipment when air quality worsens.

segments.src: Karhutla di lahan gambut umumnya lebih sulit dipadamkan dibandingkan kebakaran di lahan mineral karena api dapat menjalar dan membara di bawah permukaan tanah, sehingga proses pemadaman membutuhkan waktu yang lebih lama meski hujan turun di permukaan.
segments.tr: Forest fires on peatlands are generally more difficult to extinguish compared to fires on mineral lands because the fire can spread and smolder beneath the soil surface, so the extinguishing process takes longer even if it rains on the surface.

segments.src: ## Tips Menjaga Kesehatan Saat Kabut Asap
segments.tr: ## Tips for Maintaining Health During Haze

segments.src: Bagi warga yang berada di wilayah terdampak asap, beberapa langkah sederhana berikut dapat membantu mengurangi risiko kesehatan:
segments.tr: For residents in areas affected by smoke, the following simple steps can help reduce health risks:

segments.src: 1. Pantau indeks kualitas udara (AQI) di wilayah masing-masing melalui aplikasi atau situs resmi sebelum beraktivitas di luar ruangan.
segments.tr: 1. Monitor the air quality index (AQI) in your respective areas through official applications or websites before engaging in outdoor activities.

segments.src: 2. Gunakan masker yang mampu menyaring partikel halus (misalnya masker N95) saat harus beraktivitas di luar rumah.
segments.tr: 2. Use a mask capable of filtering fine particles (e.g., an N95 mask) when you must engage in activities outside the home.

segments.src: 3. Tutup pintu dan jendela, serta gunakan alat penyaring udara di dalam ruangan bila tersedia.
segments.tr: 3. Close doors and windows, and use an air purifier indoors if available.

segments.src: 4. Perbanyak konsumsi air putih dan hindari aktivitas fisik berat di luar ruangan saat kualitas udara buruk.
segments.tr: 4. Increase water consumption and avoid strenuous physical activity outdoors when air quality is poor.

segments.src: 5. Segera periksakan diri ke fasilitas kesehatan terdekat apabila mengalami sesak napas, batuk berkepanjangan, atau iritasi mata dan tenggorokan yang tidak kunjung membaik.
segments.tr: 5. Immediately check yourself at the nearest health facility if you experience shortness of breath, prolonged coughing, or eye and throat irritation that does not improve.

segments.src: Situasi ini menjadi pengingat bahwa dampak karhutla tidak mengenal batas administratif maupun batas negara.
segments.tr: This situation serves as a reminder that the impact of forest fires knows no administrative or national boundaries.

segments.src: Kerja sama lintas daerah dan lintas negara, ditambah kesiapsiagaan individu dalam menjaga kesehatan, menjadi kunci untuk melewati fase kritis musim kemarau ini hingga curah hujan kembali normal.
segments.tr: Cross-regional and cross-border cooperation, coupled with individual preparedness in maintaining health, is the key to getting through this critical phase of the dry season until rainfall returns to normal.

id-20260911-news-2.title: Indonesia's External Debt Reaches US$453.4 Billion in Q2 2026, BI Claims Structure Remains Healthy

segments.src: Bank Indonesia (BI) melaporkan posisi utang luar negeri (ULN) nasional pada kuartal II 2026 mencapai US$453,4 miliar.
segments.tr: Bank Indonesia (BI) reported that the national external debt (ULN) position in the second quarter of 2026 reached US$453.4 billion.

segments.src: Angka ini mencerminkan pertumbuhan 4,4 persen secara tahunan (year on year/yoy), dengan rasio ULN terhadap Produk Domestik Bruto (PDB) berada di level 30,6 persen.
segments.tr: This figure reflects a 4.4 percent year-on-year (yoy) growth, with the external debt-to-Gross Domestic Product (GDP) ratio standing at 30.6 percent.

segments.src: Data tersebut kini menjadi salah satu perhatian utama pelaku pasar menjelang Rapat Dewan Gubernur (RDG) BI yang dijadwalkan berlangsung akhir September 2026.
segments.tr: The data has now become a key focus for market participants ahead of the BI Board of Governors Meeting (RDG) scheduled for late September 2026.
## Details of External Debt Growth

segments.src: Menurut keterangan resmi BI, pertumbuhan ULN pada periode ini ditopang oleh kombinasi kebutuhan pembiayaan pemerintah maupun korporasi swasta.
segments.tr: According to an official statement from BI, external debt growth in this period was supported by a combination of financing needs from both the government and the private corporate sector.

segments.src: BI menegaskan bahwa peningkatan nominal utang tidak serta-merta menjadi indikator risiko, selama pertumbuhannya masih sejalan dengan kapasitas perekonomian nasional untuk membayar kewajiban tersebut.
segments.tr: BI emphasized that the increase in nominal debt does not automatically indicate risk, as long as its growth remains in line with the national economy's capacity to service such obligations.

segments.src: Rasio ULN terhadap PDB sebesar 30,6 persen tersebut, menurut BI, masih berada dalam batas yang tergolong sehat dibandingkan negara-negara berkembang lain dengan karakteristik ekonomi serupa.
segments.tr: The external debt-to-GDP ratio of 30.6 percent, according to BI, remains within a healthy range compared to other developing countries with similar economic characteristics.

segments.src: Otoritas moneter menyebut struktur ULN Indonesia relatif terjaga karena didominasi oleh utang jangka panjang, sehingga risiko pembayaran dalam waktu dekat dinilai masih dapat dikelola.
segments.tr: The monetary authority stated that Indonesia's external debt structure is relatively maintained because it is dominated by long-term debt, so repayment risks in the near term are considered manageable.
## Claims of a Controlled Structure

segments.src: BI menyampaikan bahwa pengelolaan ULN terus dipantau melalui sejumlah indikator kehati-hatian, termasuk komposisi valuta asing, tenor pinjaman, dan rasio pembayaran utang (debt service ratio).
segments.tr: BI stated that external debt management continues to be monitored through a number of prudential indicators, including foreign currency composition, loan tenors, and the debt service ratio.

segments.src: Bank sentral menyatakan komitmennya untuk terus memantau perkembangan ULN swasta maupun publik agar tetap mendukung stabilitas eksternal, di tengah dinamika suku bunga global dan pergerakan nilai tukar yang masih fluktuatif.
segments.tr: The central bank expressed its commitment to continue monitoring the development of both private and public external debt to ensure it supports external stability, amidst global interest rate dynamics and exchange rate movements that remain volatile.

segments.src: Meski demikian, sejumlah kalangan mengingatkan pentingnya kewaspadaan terhadap potensi tekanan dari sisi global, seperti perubahan arah kebijakan moneter negara maju maupun gejolak harga komoditas, yang berpotensi memengaruhi kemampuan pembiayaan luar negeri ke depan.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, some parties have reminded of the importance of vigilance against potential pressures from the global side, such as changes in the direction of monetary policy in developed countries or commodity price volatility, which could potentially affect future external financing capabilities.
## Market Spotlight Ahead of BI Board of Governors Meeting

segments.src: Data ULN ini muncul di saat pelaku pasar tengah menantikan hasil Rapat Dewan Gubernur BI yang akan digelar akhir September 2026.
segments.tr: This external debt data emerged at a time when market participants are awaiting the results of the BI Board of Governors Meeting to be held in late September 2026.

segments.src: Sejumlah analis menilai perkembangan ULN dapat menjadi salah satu pertimbangan tambahan bagi bank sentral dalam merumuskan arah kebijakan moneter, di samping indikator inflasi, nilai tukar rupiah, dan kondisi likuiditas di pasar keuangan domestik.
segments.tr: A number of analysts believe that external debt developments could be an additional consideration for the central bank in formulating the direction of monetary policy, alongside indicators of inflation, the rupiah exchange rate, and liquidity conditions in the domestic financial market.

segments.src: Pasar keuangan diperkirakan akan mencermati pernyataan resmi BI pasca-RDG untuk melihat sejauh mana faktor eksternal, termasuk posisi utang luar negeri, turut memengaruhi sikap kebijakan yang akan diambil.
segments.tr: The financial market is expected to closely observe BI's official statement post-meeting to see to what extent external factors, including the external debt position, contribute to influencing the policy stance that will be taken.
## Notes for Readers

segments.src: Perkembangan data makroekonomi seperti ULN bersifat dinamis dan dapat berubah seiring rilis data resmi berikutnya dari Bank Indonesia.
segments.tr: Macroeconomic data developments such as external debt are dynamic and may change following the release of subsequent official data from Bank Indonesia.

segments.src: Pembaca yang membutuhkan analisis lebih mendalam untuk kebutuhan investasi atau pengambilan keputusan finansial disarankan untuk merujuk pada publikasi resmi Bank Indonesia serta berkonsultasi dengan penasihat keuangan profesional.
segments.tr: Readers who require more in-depth analysis for investment purposes or financial decision-making are advised to refer to official Bank Indonesia publications and consult with professional financial advisors.

id-20260911-news-3.title: Red Cayenne Pepper Price Hits Rp92,350 per Kg, New Record Due to Long Drought

segments.src: Harga cabai rawit merah di sejumlah pasar tradisional kembali melonjak tajam dan mencatatkan level tertinggi sepanjang September 2026.
segments.tr: The price of red cayenne pepper in a number of traditional markets has surged sharply again, recording its highest level throughout September 2026.

segments.src: Berdasarkan pemantauan harga pangan, komoditas ini menembus angka Rp92.350 per kilogram setelah naik lebih dari 11 persen hanya dalam sehari, melanjutkan tren kenaikan yang sudah berlangsung sepekan terakhir.
segments.tr: Based on food price monitoring, this commodity has broken through the Rp92,350 per kilogram mark after rising more than 11 percent in just one day, continuing an upward trend that has been ongoing for the past week.
## Consecutive Weekly Increases

segments.src: Lonjakan harga cabai rawit merah bukan terjadi tiba-tiba.
segments.tr: The spike in red cayenne pepper prices did not happen suddenly.

segments.src: Selama sepekan terakhir, harga komoditas ini terpantau naik secara bertahap namun konsisten di berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: Over the past week, the price of this commodity has been observed to rise gradually but consistently in various regions.

segments.src: Kenaikan yang terjadi dalam satu hari terakhir tergolong signifikan dan membuat harga cabai rawit merah menjadi salah satu yang tertinggi dibanding komoditas dapur lainnya saat ini.
segments.tr: The increase that occurred in the last day is classified as significant and makes the price of red cayenne pepper one of the highest compared to other kitchen commodities at this time.

segments.src: Bagi ibu rumah tangga dan pedagang kaki lima yang mengandalkan cabai sebagai bahan baku utama, kenaikan ini terasa cukup memberatkan.
segments.tr: For housewives and street vendors who rely on chili as a main ingredient, this increase feels quite burdensome.

segments.src: Tidak sedikit emak-emak yang mengaku harus memutar otak untuk menyesuaikan menu masakan atau mengurangi porsi belanja cabai demi menjaga anggaran dapur tetap stabil.
segments.tr: Many mothers admit they have to rack their brains to adjust their cooking menus or reduce their chili shopping portions to keep their kitchen budgets stable.
## Long Drought Disrupts Supply

segments.src: Salah satu faktor utama yang diduga menjadi pemicu kenaikan harga adalah gangguan pasokan akibat kemarau panjang yang melanda sejumlah sentra produksi cabai.
segments.tr: One of the main factors suspected of triggering the price increase is supply disruption due to the long drought that has hit a number of chili production centers.

segments.src: Musim kering yang berkepanjangan membuat hasil panen di beberapa wilayah penghasil cabai menurun, sementara kebutuhan pasar tetap tinggi bahkan cenderung stabil sepanjang tahun.
segments.tr: The prolonged dry season has caused harvests in several chili-producing regions to decline, while market demand remains high and even tends to be stable throughout the year.

segments.src: Ketika pasokan berkurang namun permintaan tidak banyak berubah, harga di tingkat konsumen pun terdorong naik.
segments.tr: When supply decreases but demand does not change much, prices at the consumer level are pushed up.

segments.src: Kondisi ini diperparah oleh faktor distribusi, di mana biaya pengiriman dari sentra produksi ke pasar-pasar besar turut menyesuaikan seiring keterbatasan stok yang tersedia.
segments.tr: This condition is exacerbated by distribution factors, where shipping costs from production centers to major markets also adjust in line with the limited stock available.
## Impact on Traders and Consumers

segments.src: Beberapa pedagang di pasar tradisional mengaku kesulitan menentukan harga jual yang wajar karena fluktuasi harga dari pemasok yang terjadi hampir setiap hari.
segments.tr: Some traders in traditional markets admit they are having difficulty determining a fair selling price because of price fluctuations from suppliers that occur almost every day.

segments.src: Sebagian pedagang memilih mengurangi jumlah stok yang dibeli untuk menghindari risiko kerugian, sementara sebagian lain tetap menjual dengan margin yang lebih tipis demi mempertahankan pelanggan.
segments.tr: Some traders choose to reduce the amount of stock purchased to avoid the risk of loss, while others continue to sell with thinner margins to retain customers.

segments.src: Di sisi konsumen, kenaikan harga cabai rawit merah turut memengaruhi pengeluaran rumah tangga, terutama bagi keluarga yang terbiasa mengonsumsi masakan pedas sebagai bagian dari menu harian.
segments.tr: On the consumer side, the rise in red cayenne pepper prices also affects household expenses, especially for families accustomed to consuming spicy dishes as part of their daily menu.

segments.src: Beberapa warga bahkan mulai beralih sementara ke jenis cabai lain yang harganya relatif lebih stabil, atau mengurangi takaran penggunaan cabai dalam masakan.
segments.tr: Some residents have even started to temporarily switch to other types of chili whose prices are relatively more stable, or reduce the amount of chili used in cooking.
## Efforts to Maintain Price Stability

segments.src: Fluktuasi harga komoditas hortikultura seperti cabai memang kerap terjadi menjelang atau selama musim kemarau, dan biasanya menjadi perhatian instansi terkait yang bertugas memantau ketersediaan serta stabilitas harga pangan di pasar.
segments.tr: Fluctuations in the prices of horticultural commodities such as chili often occur before or during the dry season, and usually become a concern for relevant agencies tasked with monitoring the availability and stability of food prices in the market.

segments.src: Operasi pasar dan koordinasi distribusi antarwilayah umumnya menjadi salah satu langkah yang ditempuh untuk membantu meredam gejolak harga hingga pasokan kembali normal.
segments.tr: Market operations and inter-regional distribution coordination are generally one of the steps taken to help dampen price volatility until supply returns to normal.

segments.src: Masyarakat disarankan untuk memantau perkembangan harga di pasar terdekat serta bijak dalam berbelanja, misalnya dengan membeli sesuai kebutuhan agar tidak terjadi penumpukan stok di tingkat rumah tangga yang justru dapat memperburuk tekanan permintaan.
segments.tr: The public is advised to monitor price developments in the nearest market and be wise in shopping, for example by buying according to needs so that there is no stock accumulation at the household level which could actually worsen demand pressure.
## When Are Prices Expected to Return to Normal?

segments.src: Sejumlah pelaku pasar memperkirakan harga cabai rawit merah berpotensi berangsur turun apabila curah hujan mulai kembali normal di sentra-sentra produksi utama, sehingga proses tanam dan panen dapat berjalan sesuai siklus biasanya.
segments.tr: A number of market players estimate that the price of red cayenne pepper has the potential to gradually decrease if rainfall begins to return to normal in major production centers, so that planting and harvesting processes can proceed according to the usual cycle.

segments.src: Namun, selama musim kemarau masih berlangsung, potensi fluktuasi harga di pasar tetap perlu diwaspadai oleh pedagang maupun konsumen.
segments.tr: However, as long as the dry season continues, the potential for price fluctuations in the market still needs to be watched out for by both traders and consumers.

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat yang ingin menyiasati kenaikan harga, beberapa alternatif seperti menanam cabai secara mandiri dalam skala kecil di rumah, memanfaatkan cabai kering atau olahan, maupun menyesuaikan pola belanja mingguan dapat menjadi solusi sementara hingga harga di pasar kembali stabil.
segments.tr: For people who want to get around the price increase, several alternatives such as growing chili independently on a small scale at home, utilizing dried or processed chili, or adjusting weekly shopping patterns can be temporary solutions until prices in the market return to stable.

id-20260911-intro-marketing-8.title: [Marketing #8] Why Does Rp99,000 Feel So Much Cheaper Than Rp100,000?

segments.src: > Harga adalah satu-satunya elemen bauran pemasaran yang menghasilkan uang — sisanya (produk, tempat, promosi) justru menghabiskan uang. Karena itu, menentukan harga bukan soal menutup biaya saja, tapi soal menakar nilai di mata pelanggan.
segments.tr: > Price is the only element of the marketing mix that generates revenue — the rest (product, place, promotion) simply cost money. Therefore, setting a price is not just about covering costs, but about measuring value in the eyes of the customer.
## Today's Concept

segments.src: Banyak pemilik usaha menentukan harga dengan satu kalimat: "modalnya sekian, ambil untung sekian."
segments.tr: Many business owners set prices with a single sentence: "the cost is this much, take a profit of that much."

segments.src: Cara itu tidak salah, tapi hanya satu dari tiga cara berpikir yang dipakai pemasar profesional.
segments.tr: That method is not wrong, but it is only one of three ways of thinking used by professional marketers.
Three basic pricing approaches**

segments.src: - **Berbasis biaya (cost-based).** Hitung biaya per unit, lalu tambahkan margin. Sederhana dan aman, tapi buta terhadap pelanggan dan pesaing. Rumus umumnya:
segments.tr: - **Cost-based.** Calculate the cost per unit, then add a margin. Simple and safe, but blind to customers and competitors. The general formula:

segments.src: Harga jual = Biaya per unit / (1 - margin yang diinginkan)
segments.tr: Harga jual = Biaya per unit / (1 - margin yang diinginkan)

segments.src: Contoh: biaya Rp60.000, ingin margin 25% dari harga jual
segments.tr: Contoh: biaya Rp60.000, ingin margin 25% dari harga jual

segments.src: Catatan penting: margin 25% *dari harga jual* tidak sama dengan menambah 25% *di atas biaya* (yang hasilnya cuma Rp75.000).
segments.tr: Important note: a 25% margin *from the selling price* is not the same as adding 25% *above the cost* (which only results in Rp75,000).

segments.src: Salah pakai rumus ini adalah penyebab klasik untung tipis yang tidak disadari.
segments.tr: Using this formula incorrectly is a classic cause of unconscious thin profits.

segments.src: - **Berbasis nilai (value-based).** Mulai dari pertanyaan terbalik: seberapa besar manfaat yang dirasakan pelanggan, dan berapa mereka rela bayar? Baru dari situ produk dan biayanya dirancang. Inilah alasan sebotol air minum bisa Rp5.000 di minimarket dan Rp25.000 di lobi hotel — isinya sama, konteks nilainya berbeda.
segments.tr: - **Value-based.** Start from the reverse question: how much benefit does the customer perceive, and how much are they willing to pay? Only from there are the product and costs designed. This is the reason a bottle of drinking water can be Rp5,000 at a minimart and Rp25,000 in a hotel lobby — the contents are the same, the value context is different.

segments.src: - **Berbasis persaingan (competition-based).** Harga mengikuti atau sengaja menyimpang dari harga pasar. Cocok di kategori yang produknya mirip-mirip, misalnya pulsa, beras, atau minyak goreng kemasan.
segments.tr: - **Competition-based.** Prices follow or deliberately deviate from market prices. Suitable in categories where products are similar, for example phone credit, rice, or packaged cooking oil.

segments.src: Untuk produk baru, ada dua strategi klasik: **price skimming** (masuk dengan harga tinggi ke segmen yang paling ingin duluan, lalu turun bertahap — pola ponsel flagship) dan **penetration pricing** (masuk dengan harga rendah untuk merebut pangsa pasar cepat — pola aplikasi dompet digital di masa awal).
segments.tr: For new products, there are two classic strategies: **price skimming** (entering with a high price to the segment that wants it most first, then dropping gradually — the flagship phone pattern) and **penetration pricing** (entering with a low price to capture market share quickly — the early digital wallet app pattern).
Psychological pricing**

segments.src: Angka tidak dibaca otak secara netral.
segments.tr: Numbers are not read neutrally by the brain.

segments.src: - **Charm pricing / harga ganjil.** Rp99.000 dibaca otak "sembilan puluh ribuan", bukan "seratus ribu", karena kita memproses digit paling kiri lebih dulu. Selisihnya seribu rupiah, tapi kesannya satu kelas harga lebih murah.
segments.tr: - **Charm pricing / odd pricing.** Rp99,000 is read by the brain as "ninety thousand-ish," not "one hundred thousand," because we process the leftmost digit first. The difference is a thousand rupiah, but it feels one price class cheaper.

segments.src: - **Prestige pricing.** Kebalikannya. Untuk barang mewah, angka bulat seperti Rp1.500.000 justru terasa lebih berkelas daripada Rp1.499.000, karena harga ganjil mengirim sinyal "diskonan".
segments.tr: - **Prestige pricing.** The opposite. For luxury goods, round numbers like Rp1,500,000 actually feel classier than Rp1,499,000, because odd prices send a "discounted" signal.

segments.src: - **Price anchoring (jangkar harga).** Angka pertama yang dilihat jadi patokan menilai angka berikutnya. Menu yang menampilkan "coret Rp150.000 → Rp89.000" bekerja lewat mekanisme ini.
segments.tr: - **Price anchoring.** The first number seen becomes the benchmark for evaluating subsequent numbers. Menus featuring "crossed out Rp150,000 → Rp89,000" work through this mechanism.

segments.src: - **Bundling.** Paket hemat membuat pembanding per item jadi kabur, sekaligus menaikkan nilai transaksi rata-rata.
segments.tr: - **Bundling.** Value packages blur per-item comparisons while increasing the average transaction value.

segments.src: Perlu jujur di sini: efek-efek ini nyata tapi tidak sekuat mitos populernya.
segments.tr: To be honest here: these effects are real but not as strong as their popular myth.

segments.src: Besarnya bergantung pada kategori produk dan seberapa sering pelanggan membeli barang itu.
segments.tr: Their magnitude depends on the product category and how often customers buy that item.
Price discrimination**

segments.src: Menjual produk yang pada dasarnya sama dengan harga berbeda ke segmen berbeda — bukan karena biayanya berbeda, tapi karena kesediaan membayarnya berbeda.
segments.tr: Selling essentially the same product at different prices to different segments — not because the costs are different, but because willingness to pay is different.
Common forms are distinguished based on:

segments.src: - **Waktu** — tiket pesawat Jakarta–Denpasar saat libur Lebaran vs hari kerja biasa.
segments.tr: - **Time** — Jakarta–Denpasar airline tickets during the Eid holiday vs ordinary workdays.

segments.src: - **Tempat** — kursi depan dan kursi belakang di konser yang sama.
segments.tr: - **Place** — front seats and back seats at the same concert.

segments.src: - **Segmen pelanggan** — harga khusus pelajar atau lansia.
segments.tr: - **Customer segment** — special prices for students or seniors.

segments.src: - **Versi produk** — langganan aplikasi versi gratis, standar, dan premium.
segments.tr: - **Product version** — free, standard, and premium app subscriptions.

segments.src: Strategi ini hanya berhasil bila empat syarat terpenuhi: segmen bisa dipisahkan, harga murah tidak bocor dijual ulang ke segmen mahal, biaya memisahkan segmen lebih kecil dari tambahan pendapatan, dan pelanggan tidak merasa diperlakukan tidak adil.
segments.tr: This strategy only succeeds if four conditions are met: segments can be separated, low prices do not leak by being resold to expensive segments, the cost of separating segments is smaller than the additional revenue, and customers do not feel treated unfairly.

segments.src: Syarat terakhir sering diremehkan — dan itu sumber kegaduhan publik yang paling mahal.
segments.tr: The last condition is often underestimated — and that is the source of the most expensive public backlash.
## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Anda membuka kedai kopi kecil di dekat stasiun MRT Blok M, Jakarta.
segments.tr: Imagine you open a small coffee shop near the MRT Blok M station in Jakarta.

segments.src: Segelas kopi susu menghabiskan biaya bahan, gelas, dan tenaga sekitar **Rp9.000**.
segments.tr: A cup of milk coffee spends about **Rp9,000** on ingredients, cups, and labor.

segments.src: Anda ingin margin 40% dari harga jual, jadi hitungan berbasis biaya memberi angka `9.000 / 0,6 = Rp15.000`.
segments.tr: You want a 40% margin from the selling price, so the cost-based calculation gives `9,000 / 0.6 = Rp15,000`.

segments.src: Tapi Anda lihat sekeliling: gerai kopi kekinian di seberang jual Rp18.000–22.000, dan pelanggan Anda sebagian besar karyawan kantor yang menghargai kecepatan — pesan lewat aplikasi, ambil dalam 3 menit tanpa antre.
segments.tr: But you look around: trendy coffee shops across the street sell for Rp18,000–22,000, and your customers are mostly office workers who value speed — ordering via app, picking up in 3 minutes without queuing.

segments.src: Itu nilai yang nyata bagi orang yang buru-buru masuk kantor.
segments.tr: That is real value for people rushing into the office.

segments.src: Dengan pendekatan berbasis nilai dan persaingan, Anda menetapkan **Rp19.000**, bukan Rp15.000.
segments.tr: With a value-based and competition-based approach, you set **Rp19,000**, not Rp15,000.

segments.src: Lalu Anda tulis di menu **Rp18.900** — charm pricing, supaya terbaca "delapan belas ribuan".
segments.tr: Then you write **Rp18,900** on the menu — charm pricing, so it reads as "eighteen thousand-ish."

segments.src: Terakhir, jam 14.00–16.00 kedai selalu sepi padahal barista dan sewa tetap jalan.
segments.tr: Finally, from 14:00–16:00 the shop is always quiet even though baristas and fixed rent keep running.

segments.src: Anda buat "Promo Sore Rp13.900, khusus pesan lewat aplikasi".
segments.tr: You make an "Afternoon Promo Rp13,900, exclusively for app orders."

segments.src: Ini diskriminasi harga berbasis waktu: pelanggan yang fleksibel jamnya membayar lebih murah, sementara pelanggan jam sibuk — yang memang tidak bisa datang sore — tetap membayar harga penuh.
segments.tr: This is time-based price discrimination: customers with flexible hours pay cheaper, while rush hour customers — who truly cannot come in the afternoon — still pay full price.
The coffee is exactly the same.
What differs is the willingness to pay.
One cup, three concepts at once.
## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Ada tiga pendekatan penetapan harga: berbasis biaya (aman tapi buta pasar), berbasis nilai (berangkat dari persepsi pelanggan), dan berbasis persaingan — praktik terbaik biasanya mengombinasikan ketiganya.
segments.tr: 1. There are three pricing approaches: cost-based (safe but market-blind), value-based (starting from customer perception), and competition-based — best practice usually combines all three.

segments.src: 2. Harga psikologis memanfaatkan cara otak membaca angka: harga ganjil untuk kesan murah, harga bulat untuk kesan mewah, jangkar harga untuk membentuk pembanding.
segments.tr: 2. Psychological pricing leverages how the brain reads numbers: odd prices for a cheap impression, round prices for a luxury impression, price anchors to form comparisons.

segments.src: 3. Diskriminasi harga menjual produk sama dengan harga berbeda per segmen, dan hanya berhasil bila segmen benar-benar terpisah serta pelanggan tidak merasa diperlakukan tidak adil.
segments.tr: 3. Price discrimination sells the same product at different prices per segment, and only succeeds if segments are truly separated and customers do not feel treated unfairly.
## ✅ Self Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Biaya per unit sebuah produk adalah Rp30.000 dan penjual ingin margin 40% dari harga jual.
segments.tr: **1.** The cost per unit of a product is Rp30,000 and the seller wants a 40% margin from the selling price.
What is the selling price?

segments.src: **2.** Sebuah merek tas mewah menetapkan harga Rp4.000.000, bukan Rp3.999.000.
segments.tr: **2.** A luxury bag brand sets a price of Rp4,000,000, not Rp3.999.000.
This practice is most appropriately called…
- (a) charm pricing
- (b) prestige pricing
- (c) penetration pricing
- (d) cost-plus pricing

segments.src: **3.** (O/X) Diskriminasi harga akan tetap efektif meskipun pelanggan yang membeli dengan harga murah bisa dengan mudah menjual kembali produk itu ke pelanggan yang membayar mahal.
segments.tr: **3.** (T/F) Price discrimination will remain effective even if customers who buy at a cheap price can easily resell that product to customers who pay high.
## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Cost-based pricing** — penetapan harga dengan menambahkan margin di atas biaya produksi per unit.
segments.tr: - **Cost-based pricing** — pricing by adding a margin above the production cost per unit.

segments.src: - **Value-based pricing** — penetapan harga yang berangkat dari nilai yang dipersepsikan pelanggan, bukan dari biaya.
segments.tr: - **Value-based pricing** — pricing starting from the value perceived by the customer, not from costs.

segments.src: - **Charm pricing** — harga yang berakhir di angka ganjil (Rp99.000) agar terbaca sebagai kelas harga yang lebih rendah.
segments.tr: - **Charm pricing** — prices ending in odd digits (Rp99,000) to be read as a lower price class.

segments.src: - **Price anchoring** — kecenderungan menilai sebuah harga berdasarkan angka pembanding yang dilihat lebih dulu.
segments.tr: - **Price anchoring** — the tendency to evaluate a price based on a comparison number seen first.

segments.src: - **Diskriminasi harga** — menjual produk yang pada dasarnya sama dengan harga berbeda kepada segmen berbeda sesuai kesediaan membayar.
segments.tr: - **Price discrimination** — selling essentially the same product at different prices to different segments according to willingness to pay.
*Answer: 1-(b).

segments.src: Margin 40% dari harga jual berarti biaya menempati 60% dari harga: 30.000 / 0,6 = Rp50.000.
segments.tr: A 40% margin from the selling price means costs occupy 60% of the price: 30,000 / 0.6 = Rp50,000.

segments.src: Pilihan (a) adalah jebakan dari menambahkan 40% di atas biaya, yang menghasilkan margin sebenarnya hanya sekitar 28,6%.
segments.tr: Option (a) is a trap from adding 40% above cost, which results in an actual margin of only about 28.6%.

segments.src: 2-(b) prestige pricing — pada kategori mewah, harga bulat memperkuat kesan eksklusif, sedangkan harga ganjil justru berkonotasi diskon.
segments.tr: 2-(b) prestige pricing — in the luxury category, round prices reinforce an exclusive impression, whereas odd prices actually connote discounts.

segments.src: Salah satu syarat wajib diskriminasi harga adalah tidak adanya arbitrase; bila produk murah bisa dijual ulang ke segmen mahal, segmen premium akan runtuh dan strategi ini gagal.*
segments.tr: One of the mandatory conditions for price discrimination is the absence of arbitrage; if cheap products can be resold to expensive segments, the premium segment will collapse and this strategy fails.*
